mechanics.title: Sneak through berry bushes
mechanics.description: While crouching, a sweet berry bush does not damage you.

mechanics.title: Timed campfire immunity
mechanics.description: Sneaking on a lit campfire or soul campfire prevents damage for a limited time. A HUD row of flame icons next to the air-bubble meter shows the remaining grace and refills when you step off. Default duration is 200 ticks (10 seconds); sneaking longer starts the damage again.

mechanics.title: Crouch bridging
mechanics.description: Sneak off a ledge without looking down and you walk across a gap as if it were solid ground, up to 3 blocks by default. Looking down past 30 degrees (default) or running out of gap makes you fall.

vanilla_changes.change: No damage when the player is crouching.
Crouching on a lit campfire or soul campfire gives temporary immunity.
Crouch bridging lets a sneaking player cross gaps of up to 3 blocks without falling.

qol: Settings (campfire immunity on/off and duration, crouch bridging on/off, max gap, look-down threshold) are configurable in the config screen.
getting_started: Hold sneak while walking through berry bushes or standing on a campfire. To bridge, sneak toward a gap and keep looking straight ahead.
editor_notes: Pack author's own mod. Adds 6 advancements (root, sneak through berries, sneak on campfire, overstay your welcome, crouch bridge, looked down).
name: Sneaky Tweaks
summary: A collection of small changes that make sneaking safer or more useful: sweet berry bushes no longer hurt a sneaking player, sneaking on lit campfires grants temporary damage immunity, and crouch bridging lets a sneaking player walk across short gaps.
